message: We've all been there—a sudden blackout can feel like a bit of an adventure if you let it! I love to gather some candles, grab a cozy blanket, and turn off all the screens. It’s a great time to share stories or play games by candlelight. If you're wondering how to prep for those unexpected moments, there's a handy resource I found that can help you get ready. What’s your favorite way to enjoy a cozy evening when the lights go out?
